'''Laurn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for [[Ditto]], leader of a [[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gang]] on [[Hallitron-7/Legends|Hallitron-7]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], she and her boss were hired by [[Ferus Olin]] to escort him to a spaceport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="LOTJR" />
